prompt:
Create one original English learning poem card, portrait, watercolor and colored pencil on warm cream paper, cheerful pastel palette, polished children's picture-book illustration consistent with a gentle educational series. Upper 52% scene: Children building a simple educational computer project in a supervised computer club. Lower 48% cream reading area with large exceptionally clear dark navy serif typography. Exact title: "Software Club". Render these EXACT SIX LINES of the poem, verbatim, all fully visible with generous margins:
Software club, software, file.
Internet, website, one new style.
Type the address, check the line.
Save the program, take the time.
Compute one number, build one project.
Focus, finish, show the design.
Do not add any other text. Original generic characters only, no brands, existing characters, recognizable artwork, or imitation of named artists. Readable text is crucial.
